mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a month indicates a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals increased consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over one month signals increased consumer spending and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over a quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
